steps.description:
The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.


Show that your robot can perform the following using a Button sensor:

1. When the Button is pressed and then held, the robot will display "Door is closing" on the LCD

2. When the Button is released, the robot will clear text on the LCD.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.


Show that your robot can perform the following:

When the Button is pressed:

1. If the ultrasonic sensor detects an obstacle within 50cm from it, perform the following together:

  • play 1 beep per second
  • display "Keep the door clear" on the LCD

2. If the ultrasonic sensor detects an obstacle more than 50cm from it,

  • display "Door is closing" on the LCD

When the Button is not pressed:

  1. display "Door opened" on the LCD

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.
